title: NonSequentialTimeSeries
description: An irregular static time series sampled at explicit timestamps rather than on a grid. Carries no initial_timestamp or resolution. Its timestamp vector lives in the store; timestamps_uri names which axis it sits on.

association_id.description: Surrogate id for this association, minted by the store. Fixed once assigned and never reused; a consumer may persist it as a durable reference.

owner_id.description: ID of the owning component or supplemental attribute. `owner_category` says which.

owner_type.description: Type name of the owning entity. Descriptive, not part of the series' identity.

owner_category.description: Whether the owner is a component or a supplemental attribute.

time_series_type.description: Discriminator, fixed to NonSequentialTimeSeries for this schema.

name.description: Series name (e.g. max_active_power), part of its identity. `component_field` records what the values represent.

features.description: User-defined key/value tags, part of the series' identity: two series differing only by a feature are distinct. Names cannot collide with another series field.

uri.description: Locator for the dense data, unique within its store. Format is store-defined, often a file or dataset path. Never parsed or interpreted here.

timestamps_uri.description: Locator for this series' explicit timestamp vector, unique within one store. Optional; absent from the other five types, which have no explicit axis.

data_hash.description: Content hash of the stored array: SHA-256, hex-encoded. Optional — not every producer computes it.

element_type.description: What one timestep's values mean and how they are laid out. The stored dtype derives from this and is not recorded separately.

element_shape.description: Per-step element shape: the trailing dims after time. An empty array means a scalar element.

array_shape.description: Full native shape of the stored array: length, then `element_shape`. Forecasts add a horizon/percentile/scenario axis. Optional for static types.

units.description: Unit label for the series values, set by the writer. Drawn from the vocabulary in Core/units.json by convention, not validated against it.

quantity_kind.description: Physical quantity the values measure (e.g. ActivePower, ReactivePower). Finer-grained than a dimension; the only quantity record when `unit_system` is per-unit.

unit_system.description: Basis the series values are already expressed in. A declaration only; nothing here rescales values. Absent means unspecified, not NATURAL_UNITS.

time_reference.description: How this series' timestamps are spelled, returned as declared rather than relabeled as UTC. Absent means unspecified, not a UTC claim.

component_field.description: Field on the owning object whose time-varying values these are (e.g. max_active_power). Free-form; records what the values are for.

application_data.description: Opaque payload, typically JSON, carried verbatim for the owning application to reconstruct its own objects. Never parsed here.

length.description: Number of timesteps. Together with name, identifies the series; its explicit, strictly-increasing timestamp vector lives in the store, content-addressed.
